1. ch27Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0022

Throughout, a gradient Ricci soliton (GRS) is a quadruple $(\mathcal M^n,g,f,\varepsilon )$ satisfying \[ \Rc +\nabla ^2f+\frac{\varepsilon }{2}g=0. \] We use the sign convention of the source: $\varepsilon =-1,0,1$ denotes a shrinker, steady soliton, or expander, respectively.
